cohort: The study included 10 women with 11 pregnancies after a complete uterine rupture.
finding: Women with a history of complete uterine rupture can have a subsequent pregnancy with a favorable outcome with appropriate care, including prophylactic cesarean section.
mod_finding: All women in the study had cesarean deliveries, suggesting that cesarean section is an important part of care for subsequent pregnancies after uterine rupture.
